lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gills, showing clear local maxima in a matrix of approximately five visible horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of white blobs, forming a coordinate-like anchor system across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from highlight on the upper edge to shadow on the lower edge, running parallel to the long axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex zone of vermiculated (maze-like) high-intensity line patterns is visible in the area immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, transitioning into the standard spot grid.
